name: SousShift AI
facts: SousShift AI builds branded no-download apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. Say it 'SOO-shift', like sous chef.
Guests scan a QR code at the table, window or receipt. The app opens in their phone's browser with no app store and no account. They can add it to their Home Screen.
Plans, setup then monthly: Menu $750 + $99/mo, Rewards $2,000 + $300/mo, Full Show $2,500 + $400/mo (most popular), Everything $3,500 + $600/mo.
AI agent add-ons are per location, per month, with no contract: AI Text Assistant $75/mo, AI Voice Host + Text Assistant $150/mo. Pick one tier.

Setup can be paid in full, split 50/50 (half at signing, half when the app is delivered), or on a flexible plan from $750 down. The flexible plan spreads the rest over 12 months on top of the monthly, with no extra charge.
Contract: a 3-month minimum, then month to month. Either side can cancel with 30 days' written notice, and email counts. AI add-ons are month to month from day one.
Your customer list is yours. You get full access and a CSV export anytime, and we never sell it or use it for another business.
Contact: secondshiftai@gmail.com, Instagram @second.shiftai, or the 24/7 AI sales line (424) 296-3303.

The call line is answered by Nia, SousShift's AI guide. She explains the plans and add-ons, answers questions about SousShift and connects callers to Antidote. It is calls only, and texts to that number don't work yet.

Live demos: Melody Bar & Grill (flight game over LAX), Nalu Vida (Ride the Nalu surf game), Gritz N Wafflez (Order Up!), StormBurger (Storm Run), Churrito Loco (Loco Match puzzle), Lucky Dragon (Hibachi Catch), plus an ice cream truck app, a food truck app and a mechanic app.
Melody Bar & Grill in Westchester by LAX is the first onboarded partner and is going live now. Nalu Vida and Gritz N Wafflez are in the works and not live yet. The other apps are demo samples.
A free sample app is built with your real name, menu and photos. Antidote reviews each request personally, usually the same day. No card and no pressure.
The app menu is available in 12 languages, and the staff app is in English and Spanish.
The app works with any register (Toast, Square, Clover and others). It sits on top of your register and doesn't replace it.
Results are not guaranteed. Calculators on the site are estimates, not promises of sales.
Existing clients keep their signed deals exactly as agreed. The prices here are for new restaurants.

qa.q: What is SousShift AI?
qa.a: SousShift AI builds your business its own branded app with a custom game, rewards and a menu, so customers come back. It's made for restaurants and local businesses.

qa.q: How does it work for my customers?
qa.a: Guests scan a QR code on the table, window or receipt and the app opens in their phone's browser. They play your game, join your rewards and come back.

qa.q: How much does it cost?
qa.a: There are four plans: Menu $750 setup + $99/mo, Rewards $2,000 + $300/mo, Full Show $2,500 + $400/mo, and Everything $3,500 + $600/mo. Setup is one-time and the monthly is per business.

qa.q: What's in the Menu plan?
qa.a: Menu is $750 setup + $99/mo. It includes your own app with no download, a 4K photo menu with table ordering, 12 languages, a map and Google reviews button, and QR table tents.

qa.q: What's in the Rewards plan?
qa.a: Rewards is $2,000 setup + $300/mo. It includes everything in Menu plus your own custom game with a weekly leaderboard, points with scan-to-earn and visit levels, a birthday club and your customer list.

qa.q: What's in the Full Show plan?
qa.a: Full Show is $2,500 setup + $400/mo and is the most popular. It includes everything in Rewards plus referrals, text blasts to your list, special deals, build-your-meal and a motion menu where drinks pour and food steams.

qa.q: What's in the Everything plan?
qa.a: Everything is $3,500 setup + $600/mo. It includes everything in Full Show plus an AI agent that answers your phone 24/7, AI email and win-back campaigns, and a promo video ad.

qa.q: Which plan should I pick?
qa.a: Menu if you just want a polished ordering menu. Rewards if you want the game and points. Full Show if you want referrals and text blasts, which is our most popular. Everything if you also want the AI phone agent and win-back campaigns.

qa.q: What's the most popular plan?
qa.a: Full Show at $2,500 setup + $400/mo is the most popular plan.

qa.q: Is there a setup fee?
qa.a: Yes. Setup is one-time: $750 for Menu, $2,000 for Rewards, $2,500 for Full Show and $3,500 for Everything. Then you pay the monthly price.

qa.q: What's included in every app?
qa.a: Every app has your menu, a game made for you, instant rewards, your customer list, one-tap Google review button, 12 languages and no download. Some tools come with specific plans, so check the plan details.

qa.q: What's an add-on and what's included?
qa.a: The plan features are included. The AI Text Assistant ($75/mo), AI Voice Host + Text ($150/mo), Social & SEO Growth ($1,000/mo), Online Ordering and some extras are add-ons. The Everything plan already includes an AI phone agent.

qa.q: How much do the AI agents cost?
qa.a: The AI Text Assistant is $75/mo and the AI Voice Host + Text is $150/mo. Both are per location, month to month.

qa.q: What is the AI Text Assistant?
qa.a: For $75/mo per location, guests text your number and an AI texts back 24/7 about hours, menu, specials, reservation requests and catering. Missed calls get a text back, and anything it can't answer goes to you. 1,000 texts a month are included.

qa.q: What is the AI Voice Host?
qa.a: For $150/mo per location, a natural AI voice answers your phone 24/7 or only after hours. It takes reservation requests, transfers to staff and texts links during the call. It includes the Text Assistant, plus 750 minutes and 1,000 texts a month.

qa.q: Does the AI sound like a robot?
qa.a: It uses a natural, modern AI voice that handles back-and-forth questions. Some callers may notice it's an AI, and it says so if asked. It never pretends to be a person.

qa.q: What if the AI doesn't know the answer?
qa.a: It doesn't guess. It tells the customer it'll get a person, then texts the question to you or your manager with the customer's name and number.

qa.q: Can the AI take reservations?
qa.a: It collects reservation requests (name, party size, date, time, phone) and sends them to your staff to confirm. It doesn't book into your system or promise a table on its own.

qa.q: What number does the AI use?
qa.a: It uses your existing number through call forwarding, which we walk you through, or a new local number we set up for you. For texting on your existing number, we register it with the carriers.

qa.q: Are there limits on AI texts and minutes?
qa.a: The Text Assistant includes 1,000 texts a month, then $0.03 a text. The Voice Host + Text includes 750 call minutes and 1,000 texts, then $0.15 a minute and $0.03 a text. We tell you before you go over.

qa.q: Is there a contract for the AI agents?
qa.a: No long contract. The AI agents are month to month per location, and you can switch tiers or cancel anytime.

qa.q: How long does the AI take to set up?
qa.a: We load your hours, menu, specials and FAQs, then test it with you. Texting needs carrier registration, which usually takes a few days. Voice needs call forwarding on your number, and we handle both.

qa.q: Can I try the AI voice?
qa.a: Yes. There are demo voice hosts: Kira for Melody Bar & Grill and Kai for Nalu Vida. You can talk to them in your browser on the agents page. They don't take real reservations or orders.

qa.q: Can I just talk to someone?
qa.a: Yes. Call (424) 296-3303, any time, 24/7. Nia, SousShift's AI guide, explains the plans and add-ons, answers your questions and connects you to Antidote. It's calls only, so please don't text that number.

qa.q: Who is Nia?
qa.a: Nia is SousShift's AI guide on our 24/7 sales line, (424) 296-3303. She explains the plans and add-ons, answers questions about SousShift and connects callers to Antidote.

qa.q: Can I text the phone number?
qa.a: Not yet. The line at (424) 296-3303 is calls only. For written messages, email secondshiftai@gmail.com or DM @second.shiftai on Instagram.

qa.q: What's your email?
qa.a: Our email is secondshiftai@gmail.com.

qa.q: What's your Instagram?
qa.a: Find us on Instagram at @second.shiftai and send a DM anytime.

qa.q: How do I book a call or get a demo?
qa.a: Call (424) 296-3303 any time, email secondshiftai@gmail.com or DM @second.shiftai. You can also ask for a free sample app built with your own menu.

qa.q: How do I get started?
qa.a: Request your free sample: tell us about your business, then Antidote builds it and you see it on your phone. If you like it, we move to your plan and build the full app. You can also call (424) 296-3303.

qa.q: What is the free sample?
qa.a: A working preview of your app with your name, menu, photos and a rewards game. It's free with no card and no pressure.

qa.q: How do I get the free sample?
qa.a: Fill out the short form (about 3 minutes): pick your business type, add a few items and prices, and drop 2 to 6 photos. Antidote reviews it personally and builds it, usually the same day.

qa.q: Does the free sample cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's free, with no card needed. You see it on your phone, show your staff, and then decide.

qa.q: What are the onboarding steps?
qa.a: 1. A free demo with your real menu on your phone. 2. We build your app with your logo, colors, a game made for your food and rewards you choose. 3. QR codes go on tables and the window, and guests play, earn rewards and return.

qa.q: How long until my app is live?
qa.a: Most restaurants go live within a couple of weeks of getting us the menu, photos and logo. Your onboarding page tracks every step.

qa.q: What do you need from me?
qa.a: Your menu, photos, logo and deals. You keep the setup page current, and we build the rest.

qa.q: Do customers have to download anything?
qa.a: No. They scan the QR code and the app opens in their browser. They can add it to their Home Screen so it sits on their phone like any other app.

qa.q: How do customers add it to their phone?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, tap the menu then Install app.

qa.q: How do rewards and points work?
qa.a: Customers earn points on visits and scan-to-earn, and level up through visit levels. They get a gold loyalty card and a live reward pass, and birthdays get a treat. Points unlock rewards you choose.

qa.q: What are the visit levels?
qa.a: Members level up from Regular to VIP to Legend as they visit, and get a birthday treat.

qa.q: How does the weekly contest work?
qa.a: Your custom game has a weekly leaderboard, and the top score wins a prize that you choose. It resets each week, which gives guests a reason to come back. Gritz N Wafflez, for example, gives a karaoke shoutout to the top score.

qa.q: What is the leaderboard?
qa.a: A weekly leaderboard shows the top scores in your game, with a weekly champion. It's included from the Rewards plan up.

qa.q: Do you have a daily spin?
qa.a: The app includes a free daily spin, a weekly leaderboard and a weekly giveaway. That gives guests a reason to open it every day.

qa.q: How do referrals work?
qa.a: Customers invite friends with an invite code. When a friend joins, both get a reward, and you can see who brings in the most. Referrals are included from the Full Show plan.

qa.q: How do customers redeem a reward?
qa.a: They show a reward code or their gold card to staff. At Gritz N Wafflez, the reward codes are good for 3 days. Staff can look up a member by phone or scan their code.

qa.q: What is the custom game?
qa.a: A game themed to your business that guests play while they wait, such as a flight game for Melody and a surf game for Nalu Vida. Hitting the prize score wins something from your menu.

qa.q: What is the Melody Bar & Grill demo?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill, in Westchester by LAX, is our first onboarded partner and is going live now. Its game is a flight game where you land the plane at LAX for prizes. It has table ordering, drinks that pour, a Just Landed deal and a leaderboard.

qa.q: What is the Nalu Vida demo?
qa.a: Nalu Vida is a Venice Pier beach bar, with the surf game 'Ride the Nalu', a 4K menu, live happy-hour and brunch status, and a weekly champion. It's still in the works, not live yet.

qa.q: What is the Gritz N Wafflez demo?
qa.a: Gritz N Wafflez (Koreatown, 3183 Wilshire Blvd) has the 'Order Up!' game where you run the kitchen and serve plates. It has a real photo menu, a weekly prize board with a karaoke shoutout, and reward codes. It's still in the works, not live yet.

qa.q: What is the StormBurger demo?
qa.a: StormBurger (Inglewood and Long Beach) is a demo sample with the 'Storm Run' driving game, build-your-burger and rewards.

qa.q: What is the Churrito Loco demo?
qa.a: Churrito Loco (South Gate) is a demo sample with 'Loco Match', a Candy-Crush style puzzle game featuring their mascot.

qa.q: What is the Lucky Dragon demo?
qa.a: Lucky Dragon (Compton) is a hibachi demo sample with the 'Hibachi Catch' dragon game and a build-your-hibachi-plate feature.

qa.q: Do you have a mechanic app demo?
qa.a: Yes. The Your Auto Shop demo covers repair, tires, quick lube, body and detailing. Customers type or tap what's wrong, see a sample price or ask for a quote, check tire stock, book a time and pay by QR.

qa.q: Do you have an ice cream truck app?
qa.a: Yes, there's a demo. Customers see the truck on a live map with an ETA, and their phone rings when you're close. Rewards include 5 check-ins for 10% off or an extra scoop.

qa.q: Do you have a food truck app?
qa.a: Yes. Customers see a live map, today's stops, distance and a countdown, and can order ahead timed so food comes off the grill as they walk up. You get a live view with a cook queue.

qa.q: Which demos are live?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill is our first onboarded partner and is going live now. Nalu Vida and Gritz N Wafflez are in the works, and the other apps are demo samples built to show what we build. All of them are playable.

qa.q: Can I play the demos?
qa.a: Yes. Every demo is a working app you can scroll, play and try. They are on the SousShift website.

qa.q: What do the truck plans cost?
qa.a: Single Scoop is $99 setup + $29/mo for 1 truck. Double Scoop is $299 setup ($199 for the first 10 trucks) + $50/mo. Sundae is $599 + $129/mo for up to 3 trucks. The same plans apply to ice cream and food trucks.

qa.q: What's the difference between the truck plans?
qa.a: Single Scoop has the QR sticker, alerts, live map and points. Double Scoop adds payments setup and the route counter or, for food trucks, order-ahead and the cook queue. Sundae covers up to 3 trucks with slow-day blasts and a booking page.

qa.q: Is ordering ahead included for trucks?
qa.a: Yes, ordering ahead comes with Double Scoop and up.

qa.q: Do trucks have a contract?
qa.a: No contract. You can move up or down a plan any time.

qa.q: Can guests order from the table?
qa.a: Yes. Menu and up includes a 4K photo menu with ordering from the table, and Melody and Nalu Vida guests can order from their seat or the bar.

qa.q: Do you offer online ordering and delivery?
qa.a: Online ordering is coming soon. Pickup ordering with card payments in your app comes first, for $300/mo flat or $200/mo + 5% of the food. DoorDash delivery waits on DoorDash approval, so we don't run delivery today.

qa.q: Does it work with Toast or Square?
qa.a: Yes. It works with any register (Toast, Square, Clover and others), and nothing is installed. We connect with discount buttons today, and the onboarding page has a step-by-step guide for Toast and Square.

qa.q: Does it replace my register?
qa.a: No. It sits on top of your register. Keep Toast or Square, and add your app, game and rewards.

qa.q: I already have an app or Owner.com. Do I need this?
qa.a: Keep it. Your ordering app handles online orders, and we're the reason guests open your app when they're not ordering. We add the game, dine-in rewards and no per-order fees to guests.

qa.q: What languages are supported?
qa.a: The menu is available in 12 languages, including Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Armenian and Russian. The staff app is in English and Spanish.

qa.q: What is the staff app?
qa.a: A step-by-step training app in English and Spanish with real screenshots, a Listen button and a quiz. It holds no customer data.

qa.q: What can I see in the owner back office?
qa.a: Members, visits, rewards and prices in one place. You decide what each employee can see and change, and every change is logged.

qa.q: Do I get my customer list?
qa.a: Yes. Every signup is saved with name, phone, birthday and visits, and you can export it as a CSV anytime. It's yours, and we never sell it.

qa.q: Can I text my customers?
qa.a: Yes. Full Show and up include text blasts to your list, such as slow-day specials, birthday treats and 'we miss you' messages. Texts only go to people who opted in, and STOP is honored automatically.

qa.q: Do you help me get Google reviews?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a one-tap Google review button and a map showing you're nearby.

qa.q: What about QR codes and table cards?
qa.a: We design the QR table stickers, a 24x36 window poster and numbered table cards. The Menu plan includes QR table tents.

qa.q: Who prints the stickers and how much does it cost?
qa.a: Printing is done at a print shop. Typical cost is about $100 to $165 per restaurant for 50 to 100 stickers, one poster and 50 table cards. Depending on your plan, we can place the order at cost.

qa.q: What payment options are there for setup?
qa.a: Three: pay in full at signing, split 50/50 (half at signing, half when your app is delivered), or the flexible plan from $750 down. The monthly starts the day you sign.

qa.q: How does the flexible payment plan work?
qa.a: Pay at least $750 down at signing, and the rest of the setup is spread over 12 equal pieces added to your monthly. After 12 months it drops back to your normal monthly. There's no extra charge for the flexible plan.

qa.q: Can I put less down?
qa.a: The flexible plan starts at $750 down. More down means a lower monthly during the 12 months.

qa.q: Can I cancel?
qa.a: Yes. There's a 3-month minimum, then it's month to month, and either side can cancel with 30 days' written notice (email counts). AI add-ons are month to month from day one.

qa.q: Is there a long-term contract?
qa.a: No long lock-in. It's a 3-month minimum, then month to month with 30 days' notice.

qa.q: What if it doesn't bring customers back?
qa.a: There's a results promise. If in the first 3 months after going live there's no 30-day period where the app brought back at least 30 tracked return visits, your next 2 monthly payments are waived. It isn't a promise of sales.

qa.q: Do you guarantee sales?
qa.a: No. Estimates on the site are not promises. The results promise covers tracked return visits, not revenue.

qa.q: Is there a performance share or percentage?
qa.a: On new agreements, in any month your app customers spend more than $3,000 on food and non-alcoholic drinks, we get 10% of only the amount over $3,000. For example, $5,000 in app sales is $200. Under $3,000, nothing extra is owed.

qa.q: Are there other plan names like Basic, Growth and Done-for-you?
qa.a: Yes, the SousShift app page also shows Basic ($3,000 setup + $350/mo), Growth ($3,500 + $650/mo) and Done-for-you ($4,000 + $950/mo) for new restaurants. For help choosing between plan sets, call (424) 296-3303.

qa.q: What does Social & SEO Growth include?
qa.a: It's an optional add-on at $1,000/mo. It includes a content plan, short-form video edits, posting on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, Google Business Profile and local SEO, and a monthly report. Results vary and follower or view counts aren't guaranteed.

qa.q: What are the Sports Bar, Games Pack and 3D menu add-ons?
qa.a: The Sports Bar Package (live scores, Football Squares, fight nights), the Games Pack (trivia, word game, Truth or Dare) and the 3D digital menu are add-ons quoted separately. Ask us for a price.

qa.q: Is there a 3D menu?
qa.a: The 4K photo menu is included. The 3D digital menu, where guests spin your signature dishes, is an add-on quoted separately, and Full Show includes a motion menu.

qa.q: What is the Scout fraud guard?
qa.a: It catches point farming, duplicate accounts and fake receipt claims before anyone gets a reward.

qa.q: Are there holiday themes?
qa.a: Yes. Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and more switch on and off by themselves.

qa.q: What would this cost to build myself?
qa.a: Source figures suggest building something like this from scratch costs about $60,000 to $150,000 over 3 to 5 months, plus $1,500 to $4,000 a month to maintain. Those are typical estimates, not quotes.

qa.q: What does it cost elsewhere?
qa.a: Piece by piece, the same tools (ordering, loyalty, referrals, texting, review prompts, custom game, photos, translation, print design, video) typically run hundreds a month plus thousands up front. Prices are published estimates as of Oct 2026, not quotes.

qa.q: Does it pay for itself?
qa.a: The site has a calculator where you set your own numbers. Break-even is the extra visits a month that cover your monthly fee. Results are estimates, not promises.

qa.q: Can I use it for more than one location?
qa.a: Yes. Prices are per restaurant, and the AI agents are priced per location. Call (424) 296-3303 for a multi-location quote.

qa.q: I'm already a client. Do my prices change?
qa.a: No. Signed deals keep their terms exactly as agreed. These prices are for new restaurants.

qa.q: Do you work with businesses other than restaurants?
qa.a: Yes. We build apps for bars, cafés, trucks, bakeries, mechanics, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes, retail, boba shops and more. Ask about your business type.

qa.q: Do you have a legal app?
qa.a: We have two demos for law firms and bail bond companies: Courtroom Practice and Court Companion, which shows court dates and reminders. They can carry the firm's brand.

qa.q: Who owns the app and the game?
qa.a: Your app, game and menu are built around your brand and food. Your customer list is yours, with a full export if you ever leave.

qa.q: Is the app on the App Store?
qa.a: No, and it doesn't need to be. It's a web app that opens from a QR code, with no download. Guests can add it to their Home Screen.
